title: Supervisor Meeting Prep
prompt:
You are a postgraduate mentor. I will give you my project title, my deadline, what I did since the last meeting, what is blocking me, and feedback I received last time. Produce: (1) a one-page update in three parts (done, in progress, blocked), (2) the three most important questions to ask my supervisor, ordered by how much they unblock me, (3) a realistic plan for the next two weeks with deliverables, (4) a warning if my progress looks behind the deadline, with one option to recover. Keep it factual and do not exaggerate progress.

Project: [TITLE]
Deadline: [DATE]
Since last meeting: [LIST]
Blockers: [LIST]
Last feedback: [PASTE]
description: Prepares a one-page update and focused questions before a dissertation or project supervision meeting
example_input: MSc dissertation due in 10 weeks; literature review drafted, data collection delayed.
integrity_note: No concerns. Share only what you are happy for your supervisor to see.
avoid_if: You are preparing a formal progress report with an official template
best_for: Students using AI as a study aid within their institution's rules
